format: Perl (LightyTest.pm - Perl module for testing lighttpd)
description: This file is a Perl module that provides a testing framework for the lighttpd server. It includes methods to start, stop, and communicate with a lighttpd server process, handle HTTP requests, and check for server features. The code manages server process lifecycle, network sockets, and HTTP protocol interactions, primarily for automated testing purposes.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: This class encapsulates methods to control and interact with a lighttpd server process during tests. It manages configuration, process lifecycle, socket communication, and feature detection.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a specified file.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new LightyTest object, setting paths and environment based on build and system conditions.

methods.name: listening_on
methods.description: Checks if the server is listening on the specified port.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Terminates the server process if it is running, handling platform-specific details.

methods.name: wait_for_port_with_proc
methods.description: Waits until the server is listening on a specified port, with a timeout, for a given process.

methods.name: bind_ephemeral_tcp_socket
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket bound to an ephemeral port on localhost, returning the socket and port.

methods.name: get_ephemeral_tcp_port
methods.description: Binds to an ephemeral TCP port and then releases it, returning the port number.

methods.name: cygpath_alm
methods.description: Converts a path to Cygwin/Windows style, optionally removing the volume prefix.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process, sets up sockets, and environment variables for testing.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request to the server and processes the response, validating headers and content.

methods.name: spawnfcgi
methods.description: Spawns a FastCGI process on a specified port for testing.

methods.name: endspawnfcgi
methods.description: Terminates the FastCGI process spawned by spawnfcgi.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server binary was built with a specific feature by parsing its version output.

methods.name: has_crypto
methods.description: Checks if the server binary has cryptographic support enabled.
